models.title: Quasi-steady Kv–Rp
models.description: Rapid primary-drying screening with heat/mass balance and a moving ice front.
limitations: Representative vial cannot establish hottest-vial protection.
Prescribed pressure becomes invalid above vapor-handling capacity.
models.units: SI input keys; °C and hours explicitly named

models.title: Transient thermal vial
models.description: Adds finite vial/product thermal capacity to compare responses to scheduled changes.
limitations: Additional uncharacterized thermal inputs may dominate results.
Lumped node is not a resolved temperature or vapor-flow field.
An extra state does not establish greater predictive accuracy.
models.units: SI input keys; °C and hours explicitly named

comparison.scoring: No automatic ground-truth grade. Holdout errors use only available, provenance-labeled observations.

Monte Carlo sample frequencies are not calibrated real-world failure probabilities.
